author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
Sneak a peek at Return of the Thieves Guild, a new Season coming soon to The Elder Scrolls Online. Experience a new Thieves Guild questline in Glenumbra, take to the high seas in a new in-game event, tour Tamriel with the Prince of Madness, and encounter new challenges, mysteries, and ways to play when Season One arrives July 8.

The Elder Scrolls Online is now available with PC Game Pass as an Xbox Play Anywhere title. You can also play on PC/Mac, Xbox Game Pass, and both Xbox and PlayStation consoles. Season One arrives July 8 and is free for all ESO players.

Official Site: https://www.elderscrollsonline.com
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com
Twitter: https://twitter.com/TESOnline
Instagram: https://instagram.com/elderscrollsonline

ESRB Rating: MATURE with Blood and Gore, Sexual Themes, Use of Alcohol, and Violence. Online interactions not rated by the ESRB.

author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
HELL FREEZES OVER in DOOM: The Dark Ages | Revelations, an all-new campaign expansion that unleashes a brutal new chapter of the Slayer’s saga. 
 
Wounded and betrayed, the Slayer is thrust into a merciless purgatory only escapable by confronting haunting truths and forging new strength with the help of a mysterious ally. He must ascend from the prison of his mind and fight an abomination of the gods to set his followers on the path to freedom. 
 
Featuring new levels with deeper puzzles, new demons, and new mysteries, Revelations opens up a whole new dimension of combat. The all-new deadly Chain Spear offers returning slayers a uniquely satisfying combat system – one that rewards mastery with enhanced power and mobility. 
 
Also included is the highly anticipated Ripatorium 3.0, adding DLC content (3 new maps, new demons, and fully upgraded new weapons) plus deeper customization, improved pass code generation, and saving + loading personal presets. 

Available July 7, 2026*. https://
title: DOOM: The Dark Ages | Revelations - Official Trailer  (4K) | Available July 7

author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
Answer the call now, help defeat Infestations! Play the latest free update today! Redeem FREE* daily in-game rewards June 7 to June 15. 

Explore, quest, build, craft, and fight across a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Appalachia’s familiar places can host some unfriendly faces with Infestations! Rediscover “infested” areas across the map teeming with high-level foes and high-level loot, including new 4-Star Legendary weapons and armor mods! (That is, if you don’t all wind up exterminated instead.) 

*To obtain daily rewards, you must: (1) own or have access to Fallout 76, and (2) create or login to your Bethesda.net account.  Void where prohibited.
title: Fallout 76: Infestations - Launch Trailer
